shots.motivation: Drop the viewer into the chase.
shots.framing: low wide shot at shoe level
shots.movement: fast lateral tracking left to right, following her feet
shots.action: She vaults a grey vent box, trainers kicking gravel
shots.light_source: low sun frame left flaring behind her

shots.motivation: Reveal the goal: the waiting drone.
shots.framing: medium shot over her right shoulder
shots.movement: handheld push in toward the drone hovering at the roof edge
shots.action: She swings the messenger bag forward while running
shots.light_source: sun frame left, neon glow on the drone from frame right

shots.motivation: Land the handoff as the beat's payoff.
shots.framing: close-up on hands and the yellow cargo clamp
shots.action: She clips the parcel into the clamp; the green lights blink once
shots.light_source: last warm sunlight from frame left

shots.motivation: Release: the drone lifts away and she exhales.
shots.framing: wide shot, courier in the foreground, skyline behind
shots.movement: slow crane up following the drone
shots.action: The drone rises past the water tower; she rests hands on knees and exhales
shots.light_source: sun dipping below the skyline frame left, neon taking over
